_comment: TEMPLATE — verify schema against your OpenClaw instance before use.
_note: OpenClaw cron job format may differ from what is shown here. This template
_note2: is modelled on the general pattern at docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs.
_note3: Check your running instance's admin UI or API for the exact accepted fields.
name: weekly-content-automation
description: Publish DEV.to article, curate feed, draft LinkedIn post via Buffer

command._comment: Replace /path/to/content-automation with the actual repo path on your host.

agent_turn._comment: After run_weekly.sh exits, OpenClaw fires this agent turn.
agent_turn.prompt: Read the curation JSON at ${CURATION_OUTPUT} (from run_weekly.sh). Select the most relevant article for my audience (AI, security, DevOps practitioners). Draft a concise LinkedIn post (max 1300 chars) that shares genuine insight — avoid hype. Then call queue_buffer.py with the post text and the article URL. Confirm the Buffer draft id in your response.

environment._comment: These vars are injected at runtime from your secrets store. Do NOT hardcode values here.

retry._comment: Retry once after 60 s on failure. Adjust to taste.

delivery._comment: VERIFY: replace YOUR_OPENCLAW_CHANNEL_ID with your actual channel id.
